description: INVERTED by issue #839 (maintainer ruling #833 rule 3, "nothing shadows"). The program is unchanged — `define forward … return 55 … end` then `print fd` — but its outcome is not. This is issue #787's original host-crash repro: the expression chokepoint resolved `fd` to `forward` for DISPATCH but handed the UNRESOLVED node to `callProcedure`, whose `runProcedureBody` re-derives its lookup key from `node.callee.name`, so it looked up `fd`, got `undefined`, and dereferenced it — a raw JavaScript `TypeError` reaching the embedder with no `ol-*` diagnostic, which `spec/error-model.md` never admits. After #787 the program ran and printed 55. The fixture was marked TRANSITIONAL when it landed, and its author asked that whoever landed #839 "carry this regression forward as a lower-level evaluator test rather than simply deleting the fixtures, so the chokepoint agreement stays pinned once the source-level route is gone." Both halves of that request are honoured here: this fixture is INVERTED, not deleted — `define forward` is now `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`) at phase-1 registration (`spec/execution-model.md:82-89`), so nothing runs and the seven-event stream is empty — and the evaluator invariant now lives in `packages/runtime/src/heritage-alias-chokepoint.test.mjs`, which assembles an `Environment` by hand (registration cannot admit one) and asserts that the node handed to `callProcedure` already spells `forward` while its `source_span` still covers the two columns of `fd`. That is the surface the crash is still reachable through: `evaluate` and `createEnvironment` are public API a host can drive directly.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
